name: STOWORK
line: a carry-on that becomes a workstation
question: Can a carry-on unfold into a three-monitor studio in under two minutes?
body: A carry-on that unfolds into a full three-monitor workstation — broadcast-grade AV and a swappable compute bay for your own Mac mini or Studio — in under two minutes.
